SELECT e.contact_channel, e.delivered, count(*) AS rows, count(DISTINCT e.exposure_id) AS dist_exp, count(DISTINCT e.member_key) AS dist_mk, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS dist_mid,
 min(e.contact_ts_utc) mn, max(e.contact_ts_utc) mx, sum(CASE WHEN m.marketing_consent THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS no_consent,
 sum(CASE WHEN h.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_holdout
FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
LEFT JOIN campaign_holdout h ON h.campaign_id = e.campaign_id AND h.member_id = m.member_id
WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) AS rows, count(DISTINCT e.exposure_id) AS exp_ids, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members_any,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.delivered THEN m.member_id END) AS members_delivered,
 count(DISTINCT e.member_key) AS mk, sum(CASE WHEN m.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orphan_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19) AS holdout_rows,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19) AS holdout_members
FROM fact_campaign_exposure e LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
WHERE e.campaign_id = 19

SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS rl, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, max(etl_loaded_at) ld,
 sum(CASE WHEN member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nomember
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-25' AND DATE '2026-06-05'

SELECT status, fulfilment_type, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) ids, min(order_ts_utc) mn, max(order_ts_utc) mx, sum(CASE WHEN dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_dispatch
FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-25' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-05' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT s.store_id, w.status, count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) member_lines, sum(CASE WHEN w.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_order
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-01' AND DATE '2026-05-31' AND (s.store_id>=900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL OR f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IS NOT NULL AND f.channel_id IN (2,3))
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_lines AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.receipt_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted,
       count(DISTINCT l.member_id) AS members_with_purchases,
       count(DISTINCT l.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS net_spend,
       ROUND(SUM(l.gross_amount), 2) AS gross_spend
FROM member_lines l JOIN targeted t ON t.member_id = l.member_id

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-25' AND DATE '2026-06-05' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member m WHERE m.member_key=f.member_key)) AS orphan_member_lines,
 (SELECT count(*)-count(DISTINCT member_key) FROM dim_member) AS dup_member_keys,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-25' AND DATE '2026-06-05' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_key=f.store_key)) AS orphan_store,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-25' AND DATE '2026-06-05' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_product s WHERE s.product_key=f.product_key)) AS orphan_prod,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-25' AND DATE '2026-06-05' AND w.member_key IS DISTINCT FROM f.member_key) AS web_member_mismatch,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND f.quantity<=0) AS nonpos_qty
